result.party_text: The hearing process was difficult due to distractions, the Member's difficulty following evidence, and an overwhelmed translator, leading to confusion in the Board Member's reasons.
result.answer_quote: Given what I have seen in the transcript, this is to some extent excusable; however, this has led to a number of findings, particularly those as to credibility, that are unreasonable.
result.why: The court acknowledges the hearing difficulties and confusion in the Board Member's reasons and finds some findings unreasonable due to this.

result.party_text: The Board made a number of unreasonable findings, particularly on credibility, due to the hearing difficulties.
result.why: The court explicitly states that some findings, especially on credibility, are unreasonable due to hearing difficulties.

result.party_text: The claimants say they were beaten on several occasions by 'skinheads'.
result.answer_quote: Photographs attest to large bruising on the body of some of the applicants. There are scars and missing teeth. Two babies died - one while still in the womb when the mother was struck by several blows, the other in a melee during an attack. Death certificates were produced.
result.why: The court recounts the claimants' allegations of beatings by skinheads and supporting evidence like bruises and death certificates.

result.party_text: The applicants gave evidence of complaints made to police and police refusal to investigate or document them.
result.why: The court notes the applicants' evidence of complaints to police and police refusal to investigate or document.

result.party_text: There is evidence that Hungarian police will not document complaints by Roma.
result.why: The court acknowledges evidence that Hungarian police do not document complaints by Roma.

result.party_text: The Board Member made findings on state protection presumably with respect to both families.
result.why: The court repeats the Board Member's findings on state protection, presumably regarding both families.

result.party_text: The Applicants lawyer made further submissions with reference to reports from the United Nations, the United States, and decisions of this Court regarding state protection.
result.why: The court acknowledges the applicant's lawyer made further submissions with references as stated.

result.party_text: The respondent contended that the Board's use of 'a measure' was a standard to assess evidence and that the correct test was applied overall.
result.answer_quote: However, I am not satisfied that they were properly applied in this case. 15 The Board was required to justify its finding that Ms. E.Y.M.V. had not rebutted the presumption, in a transparent and intelligible way (Hazime v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration), 2011 FC 793, [2011] F.C.J. No. 996 at para 17).
result.why: The court agrees the correct legal principles were cited but finds they were not properly applied, rejecting the respondent's contention.

result.party_text: The claimants were not satisfied with the lack of police action, but did not take any steps to register their displeasures with any higher authorities.
result.answer_quote: The evidence is that the claimants did not make any attempts to register their dissatisfaction with the police response with any government or higher authority within the police hierarchy.
result.why: The court accepts the claimants did not take steps to register displeasure with higher authorities.

result.party_text: They simply went to one police “wicket” and in some cases did not go at all as they did not believe that the police would investigate fairly and impartially.
result.why: The court accepts the claimants only went to one police wicket or did not go at all due to distrust.

result.party_text: Protection would be available to citizens today.
result.why: The court accepts that protection would be available to citizens today.

result.party_text: The Independent Police Complaints Board (ICPB) established by the National Assembly in 2008, investigates violations and omissions by the police and substantively concerned fundamental rights.
result.why: The court accepts the ICPB investigates police violations and concerns fundamental rights.

result.party_text: The five-member body functions independently of police authorities.
result.why: The court accepts the ICPB functions independently of police authorities.

result.party_text: The parliamentary Commissioner’s office, an ombudsman who reports directly to parliament, is mandated to assist Hungarian citizens who feel that their constitutions rights have been violated by a state agency.
result.why: The court accepts the parliamentary Commissioner’s office assists citizens with constitutional rights violations.

result.party_text: Some agencies describe Hungarian government’s efforts to combat corruption as largely unsuccessful, but Transparency International regional Director Miklos Marschall stated that Hungary’s anti-corruption institutional framework was “adequate”.
result.why: The court acknowledges the statement by Transparency International's director about Hungary's adequate anti-corruption framework.
